questions.question: Who was Jephthah, chosen to deliver Israel from the Ammonites?
options: A king who ruled over the eastern tribes of Israel
A prophet who spoke the word of the LORD to the people
A mighty warrior who had been driven out by his brothers
A priest who served at the tabernacle of the LORD
questions.answer: A mighty warrior who had been driven out by his brothers

questions.question: What rash vow did Jephthah make?
options: To give the LORD a full tenth of all the spoil he took
To build an altar on every single high hill in the land of Gilead
To sacrifice whatever first came out of his house to meet him
To never again set foot in the land of the Ammonites
questions.answer: To sacrifice whatever first came out of his house to meet him
